snippet.title: STARBITES - Announcement Trailer (Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PS5, PC)
snippet.description:
Bitter—a desert planet ravaged by the aftermath of a massive war. A young salvager, Lukida, hopes to escape to the stars, but a sudden attack by a giant robot sets events into motion that will change Bitter forever.

Join Lukida and her allies as they uncover the truth beneath the sands of Bitter in STARBITES, launching on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PS5, and Steam in early 2026!

Follow @NISAmerica on X, Instagram, and Facebook for updates! 
Learn more @ https://nisamerica.com/starbites
